name: What should I ask before hiring a design-build contractor in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask in the first meeting?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask in the first meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first meeting should reveal how the firm actually works. Ask what similar projects they have completed in Los Angeles, what the preconstruction process looks like, who handles permits, and who will manage your project day to day. Also ask how they create estimates, what is included in allowances, how change orders are approved, and how they handle delays or hidden conditions. For luxury projects, ask about sourcing, finish management, and how often you will be involved in decisions. A good firm should be able to answer clearly and show examples of completed work. If the responses are vague, that is a warning sign. The best contractor is not just capable of building well; they should also be organized, transparent, and easy to communicate with from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar projects, permits, schedule, allowances, change orders, supervision, warranty, and who will be your day-to-day contact. Also ask how the firm handles design revisions, hidden conditions, and material selections. The answers should be specific, not generic.
